name: ai-design-system-demo
description: Demo repository: a design system as code, evolved with an AI agent through branches and reviewed pull requests.
author: Florian Gouloubi

scripts.typecheck: npm run tokens:build && npm run typecheck -w @bridge-ds/core && npm run typecheck -w @bridge-ds/react && npm run typecheck -w @bridge-ds/toolbar && npm run typecheck -w @bridge-ds/docs-site && npm run plugin:typecheck && npm run typecheck -w @bridge-ds/visual && npm run typecheck -w @bridge-ds/mcp && npm run typecheck -w @bridge-ds/cli && npm run typecheck -w @bridge-ds/stylelint-plugin && npm run typecheck -w @bridge-ds/eslint-plugin
scripts.build-storybook: npm run tokens:build && storybook build -o storybook-static --quiet
scripts.docs:dev: npm run tokens:build && npm run dev -w @bridge-ds/docs-site
scripts.dev:full: npm run tokens:build && npm run dev:full -w @bridge-ds/docs-site
scripts.docs:build: npm run tokens:build && npm run build -w @bridge-ds/docs-site
scripts.admin:dev: npm run tokens:build && npm run dev -w @bridge-ds/admin
scripts.admin:build: npm run tokens:build && npm run build -w @bridge-ds/admin
scripts.admin:typecheck: npm run tokens:build && npm run typecheck -w @bridge-ds/admin
scripts.ci: npm run tokens:build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint:css && npm run test && npm run plugin:test && npm run build-storybook && npm run docs:build && npm run mcp:test
scripts.mcp:build: npm run build -w @bridge-ds/mcp && npm run build -w @bridge-ds/cli
scripts.plugins:build: npm run build -w @bridge-ds/stylelint-plugin && npm run build -w @bridge-ds/eslint-plugin
scripts.mcp:test: npm run mcp:build && vitest run --config packages/mcp/vitest.config.ts
scripts.audit:docs: npm run mcp:build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js audit apps/docs-site/src --label "Bridge docs site, CI" --baseline apps/docs-site/src/data/audits/bridge-site-after.json --no-regress --fail-under 95
